stones.description: Seven stones in two groups: 2 and 5.
stones.feedback: 2 + 5 = 7. The grouping changes; all seven stones remain.

identity.feedback: At x=5x=5x=5, the identity compares 8 with 8; the equation x+3=8x+3=8x+3=8 is True. The identity holds for every real x by commutativity of addition, not because these samples prove it.
